findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no hand washing signs to be available in employee restrooms within facility. Discussed with PIC, bathrooms were recently renovated and signage was never replaced. Inspector provided facility with the necessary hand washing signage. Ensure all employee bathrooms have hand washing signs available.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.14 Handwashing Signage. A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Observed no thermometers to be present within reach in coolers throughout facility. Discussed with PIC, thermometers will be purchased and placed within coolers. Ensure a temperature reading device is available within all cold holding equipment.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed the exterior door to have light shining from below the door. Discussed with PIC, the door will serviced and leak will be sealed. Ensure staff is monitoring all outer openings to prevent any possible pest infestation.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

Observed all the reach-in coolers to lack hanging thermometers. Coolers need a physical thermometer within the unit, as well as the digital display. Purchase thermometers and place in coolers. Ensure facility has extra thermometers on hand in order to place in coolers if thermometers are broken, lost, or stolen. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent. 

Observed the exterior door to have light shining from below the door - re-seal the door. Outer openings must be protected against entry of insects and rodents. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

(REPEAT) Observed both hand sinks at the bathrooms to be in need of re-caulking. Both sinks are coming away from the wall. Re-caulk the hand sinks. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 10/13/21. 

Observed the mop sink to be missing caulk. Caulk the mop sink basin to the wall. Correct both areas by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The hand sinks in both bathrooms re observed with significant cracking in the caulking. PIC instructed to repair and maintain in good condition (smooth and easily cleanable).

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

Observed the coving on the sink in the women's bathroom to be cracking and separating from the wall. Discussed with the person in charge and directed to repair.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.

Observed the mop not stored in a manner so as to provide effective drying or deterrent for pests. Discussed with the person in charge and directed to store mop in such a way as to dry.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment: The door has not been repaired. There were apparently two separate work orders in place for the repair work, however, they have been deleted from the system. A new work order was requested during the inspection. Dollar General has one maintenance man that is sent from the corporate office. The store must await approval from corporate for the repair work.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed dented cans stored on the shelf for purchase. The cans were pulled during the inspection. Always check dented cans before stocking the shelf.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment:
Observed missing thermometers in the upright freezers. Replace thermometers.
750-230 A calibratable metal-stemmed thermometer accurate to ±2F° shall be provided for checking temperatures on food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed a broken gasket on the upright cooler holding deli meat. Replace the gasket.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Observed the door sweep to be missing on the back door of the facility. Replace the door sweep.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed the handwashing sinks in the restrooms to be coming apart from the wall. Recaulk the handsinks as necessary.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
Observed the chemical bottle in the back storage area to have no label. The chemical bottle was labeled during the inspection.
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed the mops stored incorrectly in the mop sink. Mops must be inverted or hung to dry. Store mops correctly.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similiar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment:
Observed two severly dented cans on the shelves for use.  The cans were pulled to be returned for credit.
750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed no thermometers in the reach in coolers upon arrival of inspection.  All reach in coolers and freezers had thermometers placed in them during the inspection. IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment:
Waste water was observed in two mop buckets in the back of the facility.  Waste water must be disposed of properly after use.  Properly diispose of waste water.
750-1130(e) Liquid waste from compacting or cleaning operations shall be disposed of as sewage.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed an absence of caulk at the mop sink. Caulk the mop sink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
